Notes.Text:
This update for libheif fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-84449: hOp_RGB24_32_to_YCbCr Memory Access Error / SEGV (bsc#1281829).
- Out-of-bounds read and write in derived-item and pixel-plane handling (bsc#1279444).

Vulnerabilities.Description: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. Prior to 1.19.6, Op_RGB24_32_to_YCbCr::convert_colorspace() stores image-plane strides in an integer width that can overflow for extremely large RGB images created through heif_image_create() and heif_image_add_plane(). The resulting wrapped stride causes the conversion loop in libheif/color-conversion/rgb2yuv.cc to compute an invalid input pointer and read beyond the allocated interleaved plane while heif_context_encode_image() performs RGB-to-YCbCr conversion. This can crash the encoding process. This issue is fixed in version 1.19.6.
